description: Opinionated TypeScript npm package template for ESM packages. Enforces src→dist builds with tsc, strict TypeScript defaults, explicit exports, and publish-safe package metadata. Relative source imports must use .ts or .tsx (never .js); tsc rewrites them via rewriteRelativeImportExtensions. Use this when creating or updating any npm package in this repo.
